allow: Bash(python -c "import sys,json; [print\('---ENTRY---', '\\\\nturn:', e.get\('turn_number'\), '\\\\ncommand_sent:', e.get\('command_sent'\), '\\\\nfinish_reason:', e.get\('finish_reason'\), '\\\\naction_first_300:', repr\(str\(e.get\('action',''\)\)[:300]\)\) for e in [json.loads\(l\) for l in sys.stdin]]")
PowerShell(Get-ChildItem logs | Select-Object Name, @{N='MB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1MB,2\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize; \(Get-Content logs\\bdi-interactions.jsonl | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)

PowerShell($last = Get-Content logs\\bdi-interactions.jsonl -Tail 1 | ConvertFrom-Json; $last | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; "---"; $first = Get-Content logs\\bdi-interactions.jsonl -TotalCount 1 | ConvertFrom-Json; "first entry time: $\($first.timestamp\)"; "last entry time: $\($last.timestamp\)")

PowerShell($lines = Get-Content logs\\bdi-interactions.jsonl; "total: $\($lines.Count\)"; $parsed = $lines | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json }; "nodes_committed distribution:"; $parsed | Group-Object nodes_committed | Select-Object Name, Count | Format-Table -AutoSize; "last 3 response previews:"; $parsed | Select-Object -Last 3 | ForEach-Object { "=== turn $\($_.turn\) tick $\($_.tick\) committed=$\($_.nodes_committed\) ==="; $_.response_preview })

PowerShell($parsed = Get-Content logs\\bdi-interactions.jsonl | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json }; $parsed | Group-Object provider, model | Select-Object Name, Count | Format-Table -AutoSize; "sample summaries:"; $parsed | Where-Object { $_.summary } | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { "t$\($_.turn\): $\($_.summary\)" })
